articles.title: What Does a Heat Pump Actually Cost to Install in 2026?
articles.summary: The MCS data tells part of the story. But the real question is: what are you comparing it against? We run the numbers honestly — and ask whether the grant has quietly inflated the price it was designed to reduce. The Microgeneration Certification Scheme tracks every certified heat pump installation in the UK, making its dashboard one of the most reliable sources of real-world pricing data. The numbers for 2026 are striking: the average air source heat pump installation in May 2026 cost £13,943 , with the year-to-date 2026 average running at £13,645. articles.title: The State of Nuclear Power in the UK (2026)
articles.summary: Britain's ageing reactors are winding down just as a new generation of giant plants and small modular reactors gears up. Here's the full picture, in plain English, with the numbers that matter. Nuclear power has quietly kept Britain's lights on for seventy years, but the fleet doing that work today is old and shrinking fast. Most of the reactors running in 2026 were built in the 1980s and were only ever meant to last a few decades. One by one they are being switched off.
